UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated CardUI user profile stored in Cloud Firestore under the user's Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public display name shown in navigation and user profile.

email.description: User email address from Firebase Authentication.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL (HTTPS URL or empty string).

bio.description: Short user bio or developer headline.

provider.description: Authentication provider used at account creation.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email has been verified in Firebase Auth.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

EffectStats.title: EffectStats
EffectStats.description: Public aggregated like count for a CardUI effect (ui-1 through ui-25).

effectId.description: Canonical effect identifier matching the document ID (ui-1 to ui-25).

likesCount.description: Non-negative total count of likes for this effect.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent like or unlike.

UserLike.title: UserLike
UserLike.description: Per-user favourite/like record stored in the user's likes subcollection and atomically paired with EffectStats.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who liked the effect.

effectId.description: Canonical effect identifier matching the document ID (ui-1 to ui-25).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user liked the effect.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Public, non-PII community profile for CardUI users (no email, phone, or auth provider metadata).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public display name shown on community directory and profile view.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL (HTTPS URL or empty string).

bio.description: Short user bio or developer headline.

likedEffectIds.description: Bounded list of canonical effect IDs liked by the user (ui-1 to ui-25).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest public profile sync.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Only the authenticated owner may read or update their own document.

/users/{userId}/likes/{effectId}.description: Private subcollection of effects liked/favourited by the user. Only the owner may read, create, or delete, and writes must atomically update /effects/{effectId}.

/effects/{effectId}.description: Public aggregate like counters for CardUI effects. Readable by everyone; mutations must atomically pair with the signed-in user's /users/{uid}/likes/{effectId} document.

/publicProfiles/{userId}.description: Non-PII public community profiles readable by signed-in users to view other members' profiles without exposing email or auth details.
